jobs.description:
About Mashgin

Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.

Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.

We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.

Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

We're hiring a Hardware Operations Program Manager to link our design engineers with our manufacturing partners. You'll keep the BOM accurate, run engineering changes through PLM, plan materials for new builds and mass production, and make sure finished kiosks are ready when customers need them. You will work closely with the hardware team to keep inventory, shipments, parts, and operational tasks organized and moving.

You don't need to be hands-on in every area, but you need to understand all of them well enough to spot risks early and drive decisions. What matters most is that you are organized, reliable, able to follow through, comfortable working with physical hardware, and eager to learn.

* **Impact**: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
* **Simplicity**: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
* **Hard Work**: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.

* **Ruthless Prioritization**: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
* **Customer Innovation**: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
* **Efficiency**: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the BOM. Maintain accurate, multi-level BOMs for our kiosk products, tracking costs, lead times, single-source parts, and alternates.
* Assist with engineering changes in PLM. Manage ECO/ECN workflows with design engineers, ensuring changes are reviewed, released to our manufacturing partner, and phased in cleanly—including decisions about existing inventory.
* Assist with NPI builds. Plan and coordinate EVT, DVT, and PVT builds with engineering and our contract manufacturer. Track build issues through resolution and help take products into mass production.
* Plan materials for NPI and MP. Ensure parts arrive on time for prototype builds. For mass production, work from forecasts, manage long-lead-time parts, and balance shortages against excess inventory.
* Help manage international suppliers and manufacturing. Serve as the day-to-day contact for overseas suppliers and our contract manufacturer. Follow up on schedules, quality issues, pricing, and lead times.
* Track finished goods and inventory. Know how many units we have, where they are, and when we need to build more. Partner with finance to ensure inventory accuracy.
* Be the escalation point for logistics. Our fulfillment and shipping partners handle daily operations; step in when a shipment issue threatens a build or customer deployment.
* Keep everyone informed. Share clear updates on status, risks, and next steps with engineering, operations, finance, and leadership.
* Keep inventory records and shipment tracking information accurate and up to date.
* Support U.S. domestic logistics, including preparing shipments, coordinating with carriers, tracking deliveries, and helping resolve shipping issues.
* Follow up with our contract manufacturer, suppliers, and internal teams on open operational items.
* Help organize hardware, spare parts, packaging materials, and finished goods.
* Flag inventory discrepancies, shipment delays, and other issues to the team early.
* Support day-to-day hardware operations as priorities change.
* Maintain clear records so the team can see the latest status without having to reconstruct what happened.

### **What you bring**

* Minimum of 3 years in hardware operations, NPI program management, materials management, or a related role at a hardware company
* Working knowledge of multi-level (layered) BOMs and how changes ripple through them
* Hands-on experience with a PLM system such as Arena, Agile, Windchill, or Teamcenter, including ECO/ECN processes
* Experience working with design engineers to release at least one product to market
* Experience managing materials for NPI builds and/or mass production

**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. As the Sr. New Product Technology Program Manager, you will own NPI build planning and readiness for the hardware technologies powering Uber AV Labs’ data-collection platforms. Your scope will span advanced sensing systems, embedded compute, data storage, wiring harnesses, and vehicle integration assemblies—from early engineering prototypes through pilot builds and transition to fleet deployment.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**If you’re the person people turn to when a technical problem gets messy and nobody is sure what happens next, we’d like to meet you.**

At CustomCommerce, we build custom software, AI agents, and automations that help businesses solve practical problems. We build in short, iterative cycles so clients can see progress and shape the solution along the way. Weekly demos give clients a chance to see what’s ready, test improvements in their day-to-day workflows, and tell us what needs refining. This iterative approach delivers usable capabilities sooner, helps us refine solutions around how clients actually work, and keeps their investment focused on the priorities that create the most value for their business.

We are looking for someone who can make that process work well for everyone. You might start the day helping a client explain why an AI agent is routing inquiries incorrectly, then turn that conversation into a clear issue engineering can investigate. Later, you might walk another client through a demo and get a decision that keeps their project moving. The common thread is bringing clarity to technical work and making sure people follow through. If you enjoy solving problems and want to help shape how solutions work in practice, this role gives you room to do that.

**The Role**

Once a deal is signed, you will become the client’s primary point of contact. You will lead the handoff from sales, connect the client with engineering through development, testing, and launch, and stay involved afterward to support adoption and resolve issues.

You will manage execution against the agreed project plan. You will keep deliverables moving, coordinate client decisions and approvals, and flag risks early. Engineering owns technical estimates and decisions about how the solution is built. When a client asks for work outside the agreed scope, you will clarify what they need, bring in leadership to assess the request, and keep the client informed about next steps.

**What You will Do**

* **Make the handoff from sales feel seamless.** Get up to speed on what was sold, why the client needs it, and what success looks like. Confirm expectations and immediate next steps at kickoff.
* **Keep multiple projects moving.** Track deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and commitments on both sides. Follow up on open items and bring in the right people when a milestone is at risk.
* **Give clients a clear view of progress.** Run check-ins and send clear updates so clients know what’s ready, what’s in progress, and where their input or approval is needed.
* **Use weekly demos to turn client feedback into clear next steps.** Help clients prepare to test what’s ready, capture feedback and decisions during demos, and bring unresolved questions, client priorities, and dependencies into monthly planning.
* **Turn client feedback into work engineering can act on.** Ask questions to understand what the client is trying to accomplish. Document the workflow, expected behavior, and how the client will confirm the solution meets their needs.
* **Investigate issues and follow through.** Gather examples, reproduce the problem when possible, and check whether it stems from how the solution is used, configured, or behaving. Give engineering enough context to investigate and keep the client updated through resolution.
* **Coordinate testing and launch.** Help clients test real scenarios, track fixes and approvals, and confirm they’re ready to use the solution in their day-to-day work.
* **Help deliver client value after launch.** Help clients get comfortable with the solution, coordinate ongoing support, and surface opportunities for follow-on work when they reflect a real business need.

**What You Bring**

* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can lead a client call, explain a technical issue in plain language, and write a recap that makes decisions and next steps easy to find.
* **Strong organization across competing priorities.** You can manage several active client engagements and keep track of who owns each next step, when it’s due, and what’s at risk.
* **Technical curiosity and practical troubleshooting skills.** You ask focused questions, test possible causes, and know when to bring in a specialist. You don’t need to write code.
* **Good judgment when things change.** You can handle a frustrated client, an unclear request, or a slipping deliverable calmly. You set realistic expectations and follow through.
* **Experience helping customers or business users solve technical problems.** Technical support, help desk, business analysis, software implementation, and other hands-on technology roles are all relevant. If you’ve been the person who keeps users informed, brings the right people together, and sees issues through, we’d like to hear from you. A previous Customer Success Manager title isn’t required.

**Experience That Would Be a Plus**

* A strong interest in AI or hands-on experience experimenting with AI agents, AI tools, or workflow automation. Personal projects count, too.
* Experience supporting custom software, SaaS products, integrations, or technology implementations.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting workflows, coordinating user testing, or helping teams adopt a new system.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**If you’re the person people turn to when a technical problem gets messy and nobody is sure what happens next, we’d like to meet you.**

At CustomCommerce, we build custom software, AI agents, and automations that help businesses solve practical problems. We build in short, iterative cycles so clients can see progress and shape the solution along the way. Weekly demos give clients a chance to see what’s ready, test improvements in their day-to-day workflows, and tell us what needs refining. This iterative approach delivers usable capabilities sooner, helps us refine solutions around how clients actually work, and keeps their investment focused on the priorities that create the most value for their business.

We are looking for someone who can make that process work well for everyone. You might start the day helping a client explain why an AI agent is routing inquiries incorrectly, then turn that conversation into a clear issue engineering can investigate. Later, you might walk another client through a demo and get a decision that keeps their project moving. The common thread is bringing clarity to technical work and making sure people follow through. If you enjoy solving problems and want to help shape how solutions work in practice, this role gives you room to do that.

**The Role**

Once a deal is signed, you will become the client’s primary point of contact. You will lead the handoff from sales, connect the client with engineering through development, testing, and launch, and stay involved afterward to support adoption and resolve issues.

You will manage execution against the agreed project plan. You will keep deliverables moving, coordinate client decisions and approvals, and flag risks early. Engineering owns technical estimates and decisions about how the solution is built. When a client asks for work outside the agreed scope, you will clarify what they need, bring in leadership to assess the request, and keep the client informed about next steps.

**What You will Do**

* **Make the handoff from sales feel seamless.** Get up to speed on what was sold, why the client needs it, and what success looks like. Confirm expectations and immediate next steps at kickoff.
* **Keep multiple projects moving.** Track deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and commitments on both sides. Follow up on open items and bring in the right people when a milestone is at risk.
* **Give clients a clear view of progress.** Run check-ins and send clear updates so clients know what’s ready, what’s in progress, and where their input or approval is needed.
* **Use weekly demos to turn client feedback into clear next steps.** Help clients prepare to test what’s ready, capture feedback and decisions during demos, and bring unresolved questions, client priorities, and dependencies into monthly planning.
* **Turn client feedback into work engineering can act on.** Ask questions to understand what the client is trying to accomplish. Document the workflow, expected behavior, and how the client will confirm the solution meets their needs.
* **Investigate issues and follow through.** Gather examples, reproduce the problem when possible, and check whether it stems from how the solution is used, configured, or behaving. Give engineering enough context to investigate and keep the client updated through resolution.
* **Coordinate testing and launch.** Help clients test real scenarios, track fixes and approvals, and confirm they’re ready to use the solution in their day-to-day work.
* **Help deliver client value after launch.** Help clients get comfortable with the solution, coordinate ongoing support, and surface opportunities for follow-on work when they reflect a real business need.

**What You Bring**

* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can lead a client call, explain a technical issue in plain language, and write a recap that makes decisions and next steps easy to find.
* **Strong organization across competing priorities.** You can manage several active client engagements and keep track of who owns each next step, when it’s due, and what’s at risk.
* **Technical curiosity and practical troubleshooting skills.** You ask focused questions, test possible causes, and know when to bring in a specialist. You don’t need to write code.
* **Good judgment when things change.** You can handle a frustrated client, an unclear request, or a slipping deliverable calmly. You set realistic expectations and follow through.
* **Experience helping customers or business users solve technical problems.** Technical support, help desk, business analysis, software implementation, and other hands-on technology roles are all relevant. If you’ve been the person who keeps users informed, brings the right people together, and sees issues through, we’d like to hear from you. A previous Customer Success Manager title isn’t required.

**Experience That Would Be a Plus**

* A strong interest in AI or hands-on experience experimenting with AI agents, AI tools, or workflow automation. Personal projects count, too.
* Experience supporting custom software, SaaS products, integrations, or technology implementations.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting workflows, coordinating user testing, or helping teams adopt a new system.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
